text: deepseek-bot 是面向 DSH 的常驻智能体与消息网关，可在终端、Slack、Discord 和 Telegram 中使用。它把消息平台接入 DSH 已运行的 agent 服务，并复用会话；支持跨会话回忆、读取聊天历史与附件、浏览网页、MCP 工具、终端交互和操作审批。适合希望在多个聊天入口延续同一智能体与记忆的个人或团队。需要已安装并配置模型提供方的 DeepSeek Harness；连接聊天平台时还需相应 bot 凭据。

deepseek-bot connects a DSH agent to Slack, Discord, Telegram, and a terminal. It reuses durable sessions and supports recall, history, attachments, browser access, MCP tools, and approvals. Requires DeepSeek Harness with a model provider; chat platforms need bot credentials.
想让同一个 DSH 智能体能在 Slack 里接收消息并回复。
我希望从终端继续和聊天平台上的 agent 对话。
怎样让聊天机器人记住过去会话里讨论过的内容？
想让 DSH 在回复时参考频道里前面的聊天记录。
能不能把 Telegram 或 Discord 接到已有的 DSH agent？
我想在终端用全屏界面和 agent 继续之前的会话。
I want one agent to answer in Slack and keep its sessions across restarts.
How can I search or recall information from earlier conversations?
I need a terminal interface for continuing a conversation handled by my gateway.
deepseek-bot 的功能「多平台消息接入」：把 Slack、Telegram、Discord 或本地终端消息连接到 DSH gateway 中运行的 agent，并在对应会话中回复。
deepseek-bot 的功能「跨会话回忆」：索引过去的 DSH session 消息，并提供 search、recent、show 等命令供 agent 检索和查看。
deepseek-bot 的功能「终端对话」：运行 dsh 全屏终端界面连接本地 gateway，可查看流式回复并恢复已有 conversation。
deepseek-bot 的功能「浏览网页」：agent 可调用浏览工具打开网页、按选择器点击或输入，并返回页面可见文本。
deepseek-bot 的功能「MCP 服务管理」：通过 dsh gateway mcp add 注册本地命令或远程 URL 服务，并查看或移除已配置的服务。
deepseek-bot 的功能「会话上下文」：处理聊天平台提供的近期历史和附件，让 agent 在回复当前消息时参考相关内容。
deepseek-bot 使用 DSH 当前配置的模型提供方处理会话；可选平台连接需提供对应聊天平台凭据，默认以 Slack 为平台。
本地 recall 索引由独立脚本从 DSH session 日志生成，写入 agent workspace；索引搜索按词匹配，并非语义检索。

deepbot README · Introduction：





**The agentic memory & gateway for DeepSeek Harness. Install once, then just type `dsh`.**

deepbot README · Introduction：[](https://github.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://github.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/stargazers) [](docs/setup.md) [](LICENSE) **deepseek-bot** is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
One always-on agent that remembers across conversations, in your terminal, Slack, Discord and Telegram.
Its commands run in a sandbox, and anything destructive waits for a yes in the conversation.
deepbot README · Install：```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/deepseek-bot/master/install.sh | bash dsh ``` [Messengers, the model provider and other options →](docs/setup.md)

deepbot README · What you get：- **An agent in your terminal.**
`dsh` is a fullscreen terminal: answers stream in, tool calls show with their diffs.
It writes docx, xlsx and pptx, reads links with a headless browser, looks at images, and uses MCP tools.

deepbot README · What you get：- **Memory that survives.**
Every conversation is a durable session that survives restarts.
A persona, what it records about you and the work (`USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `memory/`), and a recall index
over past conversations come into each turn. Recall stays inside its own channel; not found is an answer.

deepbot README · What you get：- **Where people already talk.**
Slack, Discord and Telegram: mention it and it answers in the thread, 👀 then progress then the end mark.
`stop` ends a turn, `usage` shows tokens, `be quiet` mutes it with a 🫡 until it is named again. - **Approvals in the conversation.**
A command that deletes or overwrites waits for the person who asked: Allow or Deny, in place.

deepbot README · What you get：- **Contained.**
Commands run under a Seatbelt sandbox that writes only its own workspace and cannot read tokens or credentials.
Text that tries to give it orders is flagged before the model sees it. - **DeepSeek's own API by default.**
A key the harness already has is used as it is. OpenGateway or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint is an option.

deepbot README · dsh：**Just type `dsh`, and the agent remembers.** A real session: it reads a file, saves a fact, recalls it in a new conversation, and asks before deleting.
Recorded on the optional OpenGateway route; DeepSeek's own API is the default.
deepbot README · dsh：> [!TIP] > Sponsored by [OpenGateway](https://opengateway.ai/), an OpenAI-compatible gateway that puts many model providers behind one API. > An option, never a requirement.

Install options

deepbot README · Others：It needs macOS with Node.js 22+, the DeepSeek Harness app and a DeepSeek API key; none is asked for if the
harness already has one. When the app is missing, the installer offers to download it from DeepSeek's own server,
checked against the build's published hash. Running the line again updates; so does `dsh update`.

```sh
dsh gateway setup      # connect Slack, Telegram or Discord: ↑↓ and Enter
dsh gateway status     # is it up, and where it found its key
```

deepbot README · Others：Without a terminal: [installing without a terminal](docs/setup.md#installing-without-a-terminal).

What's verified

deepbot README · Others：The unit suites run in CI against fakes; scenarios against a real model run by hand, or daily once
`service/install-scenarios.sh` schedules them; Slack and the terminal are in live use.
What is not verified is listed item by item in [PLAN.md](PLAN.md#unverified).

deepbot README · Others：- macOS only: on Windows the terminal runs by hand, but the installer, services and sandbox are not ported. - The sandbox is a policy boundary, not a separate OS user; an MCP server runs outside it, so add only ones you trust. - DeepSeek Harness is a release candidate and this project leans on its internals: pin your version.
